title: 0237 - SUB-DECILE: the 0233 pair-family ceiling BREAKS at exact-value resolution. Same population/null as 0236, target = exact L_next (17 buckets: odd values 1..31 + rest; max in-run 219): PRIOR 2.66830 / PAIR 2.48811 / PAIR+LANE 2.32131 (+0.16679) / PAIR+S 2.27933 (+0.20877 nats/step); within-L shuffle null +0.00149 +/- 0.00004, z = +5238. Gain grows monotonely with resolution (decile +0.0877 -> exact +0.2088): the pair family owns the DECILE but (L_g, spf(p+2)-class) is a strictly deeper conditional model carrying ~8.4% of the PAIR exact-value NLL. No RH claim
body: 0237 re-runs the 0236 transfer-matrix instrument (loom18c_subdecile.py, X = 1e8, 5,312,773 gaps with L >= 2, identical population, identical within-L-stratum shuffle null with per-shuffle refit, FALLBACK_MIN = 30 rule applied identically in model and null) with a FINE target: the exact value of L_next, binned 1,3,5,...,31 + rest = 33 (17 buckets, since L_next is always odd; max L_next in-run 219), instead of 0236's 10 quantile deciles. Ladder (nats/step): PRIOR 2.66830; PAIR 2.48811; PAIR+LANE 2.32131 (gain +0.16679); PAIR+S (128 most frequent spf values + rest) 2.27933 (gain +0.20877). Null (200 within-L shuffles, seed 18): +0.00149 +/- 0.00004; observed z = +5238. Resolution dependence: gain(LANE) +0.0517 (decile) -> +0.1668 (exact); gain(S) +0.0877 (decile) -> +0.2088 (exact) - monotone growth of the conditional spf signal as the target gets finer. VERDICT under the 0.2-nats band discipline: DEEPER at exact-value resolution (gain > 0.2), in contrast to 0236's MARSHALLED decile verdict. Interpretation: the pair family P(L_next | L) owns the next-gap DECILE (0233, reconfirmed at 1e8 by 0236: +0.088 < 0.2), but the ceiling was a statement at decile scale; at exact-value scale the local-odd-divisibility label s = spf(p+2) carries genuinely additional information (about 8.4% of the PAIR's exact-value NLL, 0.2088/2.4881) because s conditions which next-gap residues are arithmetically available (mod-q congruences on p' = p + L + 1). The 0234 'within-cell residual small and non-monotone' was the decile-scale shadow of this. This is the first clean sub-ceiling breach found by the loom track: the honest frontier moves from 'the pair family owns the decile' to '(L_g, s-class) is the deeper conditional model; the decile is its coarse projection'. The OT family (T1: s = 3 forced, 2,875,733 gaps, ~54% of the population) is a deterministic constant by construction, so the +0.209 gain is expected to concentrate in the TW population's 1,224-value spf family - that decomposition (TW-only gain, value-level table) is the immediate next instrument (Q1''), and the LEX-LEAN anchor set (T1-T5 + this resolution ladder) is now fully finite and re-verified at 1e8, ready for the WheelTile-pattern frozen-table module (Q1'(a)). No instrument bugs remain in this run (the 0236 audit list stands). Off-board side-quest. No RH claim.
